name: Lumabill API
description:
The Lumabill API gives **Pro and Lifetime** subscribers programmatic access to
Swiss invoicing and bookkeeping data. You can create and manage invoices,
clients, expenses, journal entries, and more - the same data you see in the
Lumabill dashboard.

## Authentication

All requests must carry a Bearer API key in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer lmb_your_api_key_here
```

API keys are created in **Settings → API Keys** inside the Lumabill dashboard.

## Profile scoping

A Lumabill account can have multiple profiles (companies). By default the key
is scoped to the profile it was created for. If a key has access to multiple
profiles, supply the `X-Profile-Id` header with the UUID of the target profile.

## Rate limits

| Operation | Limit |
|-----------|-------|
| Reads (GET) | 60 requests / minute per API key |
| Writes (POST, PUT, DELETE) | 20 requests / minute per API key |

When the limit is exceeded the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a
`Retry-After` header indicating when you may retry (seconds from now).

## Pagination

List endpoints support cursor-free page-based pagination via query parameters:

| Parameter | Default | Maximum |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `page` | 1 | - |
| `per_page` | 50 | 100 |

Responses include a top-level `meta` object:

```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "per_page": 50, "total": 243 }
}
```

## Errors

All error responses share a common shape:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable description"
  }
}
```

Common error codes: `INVALID_API_KEY`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`,
`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED`,
`READ_ONLY_KEY`, `CLIENT_NOT_FOUND`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

## Smart defaults

When creating invoices or offers the API auto-resolves most fields from
your profile so you can send minimal payloads. Only `lines` is required.

| Field | Auto-resolved from |
|-------|-------------------|
| `invoice_number` | Profile prefix + sequential counter (e.g. `IV-010`) |
| `issue_date` | Today |
| `due_date` | `issue_date` + profile payment deadline (default 30 days) |
| `currency` | Profile default currency (default `CHF`) |
| `vat_rate` (on lines) | Profile default tax rate |
| Sender details | Profile company name, address, IBAN, etc. |
| Payment info | Profile payment template and deadline |

**`client_id` shorthand** - pass a `client_id` UUID instead of a full
client object. The API fetches the client and snapshots the data
automatically. Returns `404` with code `CLIENT_NOT_FOUND` if the client
does not exist in your profile.

**Minimal example:**

```json
POST /invoices
{
  "client_id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
  "lines": [
    { "description": "Consulting", "quantity": 2, "price": 150 }
  ]
}
```

Any field you explicitly provide overrides the auto-resolved default.

## MCP Server (AI Assistant Integration)

Connect your Lumabill account to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor
using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

**Endpoint:** `https://mcp.lumabill.ch/mcp?key={your_api_key}`

**Setup for Claude Desktop** - add to `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lumabill": {
      "type": "streamable-http",
      "url": "https://mcp.lumabill.ch/mcp?key=lmb_your_key_here"
    }
  }
}
```

**Setup for Claude Code** - add to `.mcp.json` in your project:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lumabill": {
      "type": "streamable-http",
      "url": "https://mcp.lumabill.ch/mcp?key=lmb_your_key_here"
    }
  }
}
```

**Setup for Cursor** - add to MCP settings:
- Name: `lumabill`
- Type: `streamable-http`
- URL: `https://mcp.lumabill.ch/mcp?key=lmb_your_key_here`

The MCP server exposes all API endpoints as tools. Your AI assistant can:
- Create and manage invoices, offers, and expenses
- Look up clients and vendors
- Generate financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, VAT)
- Import bank transactions
- Query revenue data

**API key permissions apply:** Read-only keys only expose read tools.
Same rate limits as the REST API (60 reads/min, 20 writes/min).
